objectives.label: Clear the creatures from the wreck

title: The caravan that never came
Lost on the {other} road
summary: The caravan between {settlement} and {other} never arrived. Find what became of it, {distance} to the {direction}, and bring back the drover's ledger.
offer: The caravan with our {cargo} should have reached {other} two days ago. Something took it on the road. Find it — and the ledger, so we know what was lost.
complete: So that is how it ended. Thank you for bringing them home, in a manner of speaking.
